I'm trying to answer a GAIA benchmark question about Washington DC Metro. I need to find the location of "Cleveland Elementary School" near DC and which metro station is closest to it.

Please try these approaches:
1. Use websearch to search for "Cleveland Elementary School" in Arlington Virginia, Washington DC, or nearby areas
2. Try webfetch on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cleveland_Elementary_School
3. Try webfetch on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cleveland_Park
4. Search for "Cleveland Elementary School Brightwood DC"

Alternatively, try webfetch on:
- https://www.google.com/search?q=Cleveland+Elementary+School+Arlington+Virginia
- https://www.google.com/search?q=Cleveland+Elementary+School+Washington+DC+metro

I specifically need to know which Washington DC Metro station is closest to any Cleveland Elementary School in the DC area. The answer must be on the Silver Line since the question involves staying on the same line without changing.
I'll help you find Cleveland Elementary School near DC and determine the closest Silver Line metro station. Let me search multiple sources in parallel.
